prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a corrected FOUR-FRAME WALK CYCLE, not idle/purchase poses, of the exact adult game character in the reference. Single transparent 2x2 sheet, four equal cells, complete full-body sprite in each. TRUE compact low-resolution pixel art for 48x64 pixels per frame. Same head and torso reproduced as one locked piece in the exact same orientation, position, proportions and colors in all frames. No head turn, no face change, no eye flicker, no head scaling, no lighting changes. Do not bob the head or torso. Keep waist and hip center at exactly same coordinates. Only legs move, with a little clothing hem movement where necessary. Small natural unhurried steps, NOT a giant lunge. Character faces LEFT, slight three-quarter side view, no direction changes. Character is adult age 25+ in stylized compact proportions.

Four poses in row-major order:
TOP LEFT 1 CONTACT A: LIGHT camera-near leg reaches a modest distance FORWARD to screen LEFT, heel contacting ground. DARK camera-far leg stretches modestly backward to screen RIGHT, toe touching ground.
TOP RIGHT 2 PASSING A: LIGHT near leg now planted DIRECTLY UNDER hip as straight supporting leg. DARK far leg is lifted, KNEE BENT and swinging forward across the support leg, foot clearly ABOVE ground and close to the ankle/knee rather than spread wide. Feet close together horizontally, not another split stance.
BOTTOM LEFT 3 CONTACT B: DARK camera-far leg reaches forward to screen LEFT, heel on ground. LIGHT camera-near leg now behind to screen RIGHT on toe. Reverse the contact pose's anatomical legs.
BOTTOM RIGHT 4 PASSING B: DARK far leg now planted DIRECTLY UNDER hip supporting body. LIGHT near leg is lifted with BENT KNEE moving forward, foot clearly ABOVE ground and close to body. Mirror the anatomical leg roles of passing A.

CRITICAL rhythm: feet APART / feet CLOSE with raised foot / feet APART reversed / feet CLOSE with opposite raised foot. Contact stride total spread only about 10-14 logical pixels at 48x64. Close stance spread 3-5 logical pixels. Do not repeat four spread-leg poses. Keep far leg consistently darker including footwear. Fixed ground baseline at standing foot, same sprite scale in every cell. Keep costumes and equipment identical. Transparent background, no shadows on ground, no text or labels. Leave clear padding. No extra characters or extra frames. Adult female elf archer: long silver hair, pointed ears, modest green SLEEVELESS cloth top and FLAT chest, SHORT clean sage LOINCLOTH with ivory edging ending upper thigh, bare legs, low OPEN-TOE LEATHER SANDALS, bow on screen left and quiver behind shoulder. No boots or long skirt. Pale peach near leg, subdued tan/mauve far leg (not black). The bow, head, hair, face, chest and belt should be exactly copied in all four cells, no arm swing necessary because she carries bow. In passing poses visibly BEND and RAISE a knee, keep both feet close. Keep the reference's exact pixel density and modest narrow silhouette.

elf_refinement:
Correct ONLY leg depth colors in TWO cells of this exact 2x2 elf walk cycle. All four poses, upper bodies, heads, costumes and composition remain identical. Do not redesign or change any positions.
TOP LEFT: LEAVE UNCHANGED (light left/front leg, dark right/back leg).
TOP RIGHT: SWAP LEG DEPTH COLORS. The STRAIGHT SUPPORTING LEG ending in the ground-contact sandal toward the LEFT/below hip must be LIGHT pale peach. The BENT LIFTED LEG toward the RIGHT with raised sandal must be DARK muted tan/mauve. This is absolutely crucial.
BOTTOM LEFT: SWAP LEG DEPTH COLORS. The extended leg toward LEFT, from upper thigh to toes, must be DARK muted tan/mauve. The leg toward RIGHT must be LIGHT pale peach.
BOTTOM RIGHT: LEAVE UNCHANGED (dark planted straight supporting leg, light bent raised leg).
Thus each diagonal pair has opposite light/dark anatomical leg roles. Use distinct but natural shadow like previous elf design. Keep the same character and clothing, short loincloth and sandals. Transparent background, exact 2x2 layout, no labels. Adult elf archer age25+. This is a precise palette correction of thighs/shins/feet only.
